SWE task images ship commits past the base commit. SWE-rebench, SWE-Gym and R2E-Gym keep the upstream fix on a branch or tag. SWE-smith's HEAD is the bug-injection commit, so git show HEAD prints the answer. In 7,200 openhands-sdk rollouts on SWE-rebench, 16% ran commands such as git log --all --grep=<issue> against that history. In RL it is worse than in eval: a rollout that copies the fix earns reward, so the policy learns to look. They fail on main too and are left alone here. tests/unified_trainer/test_fireworks_config_sync.py was not run because fireworks is not installed in this environment. New tests: tests/sandbox/test_git_history.py (vault behavior, native and Harbor paths) and tests/unified_trainer/test_hide_git_history_wiring.py (trainer wiring, default off, startup refusals). E2E on a real SWE-smith docker sandbox through the trainer wiring, with the hooks pickled the way Ray ships them: the agent sees 1 commit and 1 ref, and after the restore the verifier sees 539 commits and 273 refs. Hiding takes about 0.1s. rllm eval --hide-git-history is in use on a long-running openhands-sdk rollout over the SWE-Master datasets. A GRPO training run with recipe.hide_git_history=true .
